text.en: GFP-GAN is row 19 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: GFP-GAN 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 19 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates GFP-GAN with “Towards real-world blind face restoration with generative facial prior”.
text.zh: 年度表把 GFP-GAN 与论文《Towards real-world blind face restoration with generative facial prior》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Xintao Wang, Ying Shan”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Xintao Wang（官方页拼写）、Ying Shan（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Xintao Wang, Ying Shan”。
